newsitem.title: USA: Hartford, First Union in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Hartford, First Union in alliance.

text.p: Hartford Financial Services Group said Monday it had agreed to sell and service insurance through First Union Corp's First Union Insurance Group.
Harford said the agreement is designed to sell insurance to small businesses that are customers of First Union.
Hartford said the agreement is for property-casualty insurance.

Hartford said the agreement marks the first time an insurance company will provide a direct response marketing and servicing commercial insurance program through a bank-affiliated insurance agency to commercial bank customers.
Hartford said the program has been launched in North Carolina, Virginia, Maryland and Washington D.C.

Among the property-casualty insurance coverages Hartford said it will offer First Union small business customers are workers compensation, business automobile, general liability, commercial property and package, and umbrella liability.
The insurer has established a unit to handle all direct mail, direct response and servicing of First Union customers.
Hartford said insurance claims will be handled around the clock by its claim representatives throughout the country.
First Union Insurance Group offers personal and business insurance products and services, including life, health, automobile and property-casualty insurance and employee benefits.
